focal_point: A family grouped at the left and a blue header fight a yellow savings badge on the right. No single element holds 35–50%.
eye_path: Z that stalls: header, family, badge, then a pile of small service lines.
grid: Loose two-column split under a full-width header. Many alignments.
scale_ratios: Headline, badge, and phone are within a narrow band. The offer is not 1.6× the headline.
type_choices: Several sizes in one grotesque plus a script logo. More than three sizes.
photo_art_direction: Staged indoor family, all looking at camera. Stock-tell smiles, even light, no equipment.
offer_placement: Yellow badge on the right is the deal, but a second seasonal line and a service list compete with it.
trust_and_cta: Phone is present and reasonably large. Badges and small print share the bottom. More than one action energy.

hierarchy.reason: No clear size ladder from offer to body.

balance.reason: Left photo and right badge are both heavy.

grid.reason: Header plus two columns, alignments drift.

eye_path.reason: Path has four stops of similar weight.

gestalt.reason: Offer, list, and phone are separate groups.

contrast.reason: Blue, yellow, and white separate well enough.

whitespace.reason: Little calm field once the list starts.

figure_ground.reason: Badge separates; type on the photo is mixed.

color.reason: Blue plus yellow is a coupon code, not a palette.

type.reason: Script logo plus too many sizes.

photo.reason: Stock family does not show the trade.

offer.reason: Savings badge is visible and not alone.

cta.reason: Phone exists; it is not one lockup with a verb.

trust.reason: Small trust clutter rather than one line.

glance_3s.reason: A glance gets HVAC and a discount, not one next step.

emulate: A full-height photo of people only if they are the customer of a comfort product, with type on a solid field.
do_not_copy: The family photograph, the badge shape, the script mark, the seasonal line.
summary: A low-resolution HVAC front in the common coupon split. Readable, and it behaves like a template: stock family, yellow badge, service list.
